CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION agent_workflow.json_extract(value text, path text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
AS $function$ DECLARE item jsonb; BEGIN IF path !~ '^\$\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF; item := value::jsonb -> substring(path from 3); IF item IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF; IF jsonb_typeof(item) = 'string' THEN RETURN item #>> '{}'; END IF; RETURN item::text; EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN RETURN NULL; END $function$
catalog.name: json_extract(value text, path text)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION agent_workflow.rfc395_collaboration_gate_operations_0_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN IF (OLD."result_gate_revision" IS NOT NULL) THEN IF (NEW."result_gate_revision" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."result_gate_revision" OR NEW."receipt_json" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."receipt_json" OR NEW."committed_at" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."committed_at") THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001', MESSAGE = 'human-gate-committed-receipt-immutable'; END IF; END IF; IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $function$
